empty.noClientsText: A library file is installed into a client. Create one and this list starts filling up.
empty.noFilesText: Find skins, hilts, maps and mods on JKHub, then add the pk3 files here. You can also drop them straight onto this window.
empty.filteredText: No file in this client matches the search and the filters. Clear them to see the whole library.
empty.updatesText: Once files carry a JKHub version, the ones with a newer release show up here.

drop.title: Drop pk3 files to install them into {{client}}

conflicts.notice: {{count}} files override each other. For every shared path the game reads one file and skips the rest.
conflicts.title: Files that override each other
conflicts.body: {{files}} files in {{client}} carry {{paths}} paths that another file carries too. The game reads one file per path.
conflicts.ruleTitle: How the game picks the winner
conflicts.ruleOrder: Inside one folder the game loads pk3 files by name, ignoring upper and lower case, and loads names that start with dl_ after every other name. Each file it loads goes in front of the ones before it, so the file loaded last is the one the game reads.
conflicts.ruleDisable: Disabling a file renames it on disk and takes it out of that order. The file stays in the client, and the switch on its card brings it back.
conflicts.folderHint: Only files in the same folder can override each other.
conflicts.order: Load order · the last file wins
conflicts.disableWinner: Disable {{file}} and {{next}} takes over this path.
conflicts.disableHidden: Disable {{file}}. The game already skips it here.

kindHint.shader: How a surface is drawn: glow, transparency, movement.

kindHint.sound: A sound effect or a music track.
kindHint.texture: A picture on a surface or in the interface.
kindHint.map: A level the server can load.
kindHint.ui: A menu screen or the text inside it.

conflicts.truncated: Only the first {{shown}} of {{total}} paths are listed. Disable one of the files to see the rest.

remove.title: Remove {{file}} from {{client}}?
remove.body: {{fileName}}, {{size}}. The file is deleted from the client's {{folder}} folder. Other clients keep their own copy.
